title: Enlargements of Rhoads flying disk photographs (Figs. 3 and 4)
description: Two taped-in photographic enlargements under the heading "ENLARGEMENTS OF ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPHS": Fig. 3 shows a dark elongated object against a pale sky and Fig. 4 a larger dark crescent or heel-shaped object with a small light spot. Typed text below describes the 10 July 1947 sighting by Pan-American Airways mechanic Mr. Woodruff near Harmon Field, Newfoundland. Page 3 of a SECRET report.
